## 7. Leave encashment at exit
At exit, up to 30 days of EL balance is encashed at Basic salary / 30 per day as part of the Full and Final settlement (see HR-EXIT-001). SL, CL and comp-off are not encashed.

## 8. Holidays
India offices follow the published holiday calendar (HR-HOL-2026): 10 fixed holidays + 2 floating (optional) holidays.

## 9. FAQs
**Can I take EL in advance?** No. Only credited EL can be used.
**What if I fall sick during EL?** You can request your manager to convert EL days to SL with a medical certificate.
**Do I lose CL at year end?** Yes, CL and SL lapse on 31 December.
**Where do I check my balance?** PeopleHub → Leave → My Balances. If it looks wrong, raise OrbitDesk → HR → "Leave balance correction".

# PTO and Leave Policy – United States

## PTO
| Years of service | Annual PTO |
|---|---|
| 0–2 years | 20 days |
| 3–5 years | 23 days |
| 6+ years | 25 days |

- PTO accrues per pay period (semi-monthly, 24 periods).
- Up to **5 days** of unused PTO carry over to the next calendar year; carried-over days expire on 31 March.
- Unused PTO is paid out at termination where required by state law (Texas does not require it, but Orbitra pays out up to 10 days as company practice).

## Sick time
10 paid sick days per year, front-loaded on 1 January (pro-rated for new hires). Does not carry over. A doctor's note is required only for absences longer than 3 consecutive days.

## Holidays
11 company holidays: New Year's Day, MLK Day, Presidents' Day, Memorial Day, Juneteenth, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day, Day after Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve, Christmas Day. Plus 1 floating holiday.

## Parental leave
- **16 weeks fully paid** for birthing parents (includes short-term disability benefit).
- **12 weeks fully paid** for non-birthing parents, including adoptive and foster parents.
- Must be taken within 12 months of the birth/placement; may be split into at most 2 blocks.

## Other leaves
- **FMLA:** up to 12 weeks job-protected unpaid leave for eligible employees (12 months service, 1,250 hours).
- **Bereavement:** 5 days (immediate family), 2 days (extended).
- **Jury duty:** fully paid for up to 10 days.
- **Voting:** up to 2 hours paid.

## How to request
Request PTO in PeopleHub at least 2 weeks in advance for 5+ consecutive days. Contact your HRBP Rachel Kim (rachel.kim@orbitra.io) for leaves of absence.

Note: US employees do not receive Earned Leave, Casual Leave or comp-off — these are India-only leave types.

chunks.text:
# Accounts, Passwords, MFA and Access

## 1. Single sign-on (Okta)
All company applications are accessed through **orbitra.okta.com**. Your username is your email address.

## 2. Password rules
- Minimum **14 characters**; must not contain your name or "orbitra".
- Passwords expire every **180 days**; you receive reminders 14, 7 and 1 day before expiry.
- Last 10 passwords cannot be reused.
- **Self-service reset:** orbitra.okta.com → "Forgot password?" → verify with Okta Verify or SMS. Takes 2 minutes.
- On Mac, after a reset, the laptop login password syncs on next login while connected to the internet (Okta Platform SSO). If it doesn't sync, connect to the office Wi-Fi or VPN and lock/unlock the screen.

## 3. Account lockout
After **5 failed attempts** your account is locked for **30 minutes** and then unlocks automatically. To unlock immediately, use self-service unlock at orbitra.okta.com or call Ext. 4000.

If your ticket breaches SLA, reply on the ticket with "ESCALATE" – it is routed to the IT team lead automatically.

chunks.text:
You will **never** be penalised for reporting in good faith, even if you made the mistake.

## 3. How to spot phishing
- Sender domain looks similar but wrong (orbitra-hr.com, 0rbitra.io). Only **@orbitra.io** is ours.
- Urgency or secrecy: "do this now, don't tell anyone".
- Requests for gift cards, wire transfers, bank detail changes, or OTPs.
- Unexpected attachments (.html, .zip, .iso) or QR codes.
- Executives will **never** ask you to buy gift cards or share OTPs over WhatsApp.

## 4. Vendor bank detail change requests
Any email asking to change a vendor's bank account must be verified by **calling the vendor on a known number** (not the number in the email). Finance must follow FIN-003 §6.

## 5. What happens after you report
Security triages within 30 minutes (24x7). You may be asked to hand over your laptop for forensic analysis; a loaner will be provided.
